My process starts with a 90-minute on-site consultation where I walk the property, take measurements, and talk through your goals. From there I develop a concept plan with planting design, hardscape layout, and a phased budget.
I have openings in the next 2-3 weeks. Want me to send over some available dates?

verticalFaqs.question: Can Duet handle the spring rush when consultation requests pile up?
verticalFaqs.answer: That's exactly when Duet shines. During your busiest season, every new inquiry gets a fast, detailed reply with your process, timeline, and availability — even while you're on-site all day. No more losing spring leads because you couldn't get back to them until 9 PM.

verticalFaqs.question: I coordinate with multiple outdoor crews. Does Duet help with that?
verticalFaqs.answer: Yes. Duet learns your projects and the contractors involved — hardscape, irrigation, planting crews, nurseries. It categorizes contractor emails separately from client emails, and can draft replies with project-specific details like specs, timelines, and materials. You stay on top of every crew without the inbox chaos.
